_comment: The CTA plan the bsuk-cta skill and the three render checks read (tests/render/checks/cta.ts). A CTA is a visible <a>, <button> or submit inside <main> painted in --color-cta; nav and [data-cta-exempt] are not CTAs. `body` counts link CTAs only (not form submits, not tool buttons), and a repeated set (one CTA per card, e.g. 'Ask about <pup>') counts as ONE. Bands are defaults from the pages measured 2026-10-08 (`measured`); the breeder changes them here, and the board shows the page's count against its band.

near_identical._comment: Two CTA texts on one page are near-identical when their content words are the same set, or their Jaccard overlap is at least `jaccard`. Stop words are dropped first, so 'Ask about a puppy' and 'Ask us about a puppy' are one button twice.

measured._comment: Body CTAs per page at 1280, 2026-10-08 (a repeated set counted once).

types.browse: to the litter: /available-puppies/ or a puppy page
types.ask-about-pup: one per puppy card, the name from data/puppies.json
types.tool: a button that works a component (a map facade, a calculator); not counted
